author: Vox
description:
As the latest Supreme Court term comes to an end, Vox’s Ian Millhiser reflects on the big losses for Democrats and big victories for Republicans handed down by the court. One of his main takeaways? While Democrats can still win in this far-right Court, they typically only do when Republicans can’t agree on how the Court should rule.

author: Vox
description:
Democratic commentators keep saying the party needs a manlier candidate to win back young male voters. 

Vox's Constance Grady points out that someone who fits all of their definitions of manliness is right in front of them. Zohran Mamdani did well with male voters, loves sports, and performs well on bro podcasts. And he did all of that without alienating women, the actual base of the Democratic Party.

So why isn't he the bro Democrats keep saying they need?
